title: Relay Evidence (RelayEvidence-v1) (v2.9)
description: A single four-corner relay hop's sealed evidence (profile-2; TS clause 4.1, FC-1). B.1-RelayAcceptance / B.2-RelayRejection are issued by the RECIPIENT-side RDP as it accepts or refuses a relayed message over the RDP-RDP relay interface; the sender-side RDP aggregates them into the Evidence Package (EP rdp_chain[].evidence, FC-2). B.3-RelayFailure is NOT a RelayEvidence object — it is a sender-side NDE with reason routing-failed (TS clause 8.1). Each object is sealed by its issuer (the receiving RDP) and carries a qualified timestamp AT THE HOP. Fields are fixed by TS clause 4.1: message_id, the sending and receiving RDP identifiers, the hop instant, a typed reason (B.2 only), the issuer's seal, and the hop qualified timestamp. NOT exercised by the single-provider (profile-1) conformance samples.

profile.description: Deployment profile marker (pilot | production), as on the other evidence objects.

message_id.description: The relayed message's id; equals the EP message_id when this hop is referenced from EP rdp_chain[].evidence (evidence_lint LINT-EP-06).

sending_rdp_id.description: The relaying (sender-side) RDP — the peer that dispatched the message over the relay interface. R8-05: declared an unconstrained string, so this evidence field admitted provider identifiers the rest of the model rejects.

receiving_rdp_id.description: The recipient-side RDP that issues and seals this relay evidence. R8-05: declared an unconstrained string, so this evidence field admitted provider identifiers the rest of the model rejects.

reason.description: Typed relay-rejection reason. REQUIRED exactly when event is B.2-RelayRejection; FORBIDDEN for B.1-RelayAcceptance (evidence_lint LINT-RLY-01). Maps to the sender-facing NDE reason per TS clause 4.1 (finding 7): unknown-uid->unknown-uid, uid-suspended->uid-suspended, policy-violation->policy-block, malformed->malformed-envelope. X-25: the value space is REGISTRY-GOVERNED, not spec-versioned — the schema bounds only the LEXICAL form (lowercase-kebab; x- = private use, never registered). The registered set and its event bindings live in registries/reason-codes.json (umbrella §13.4); registering a code is a registry action, NOT a version bump (§9.3). An unregistered well-formed code is accepted, preserved verbatim and treated generically (LINT-NDE-W1).

envelope_hash.description: F-02 (evidence 2.2): each hop attests the exact TLS-serialized MLSMessage octets it received/handed over; in a bundle it MUST equal the SE's for the same message_id (LINT-BND-25) — a substituted ciphertext under the same metadata fails at every hop. A relaying RDP MUST refuse a hop whose recomputation differs from the sending side's declared value.
